Question 9
?

Find the domain of the function z=y+22x3−y.

a
The domain is the entire xy−plane
b
{(x,y)∈R2:y<−2,y≠2x3}
c
{(x,y)∈R2:y≥−2,y>2x3}
d
{(x,y)∈R2:y≥−2,y≠2x3}
e
{(x,y)∈R2:y≥2,y>2x3}
